title: Stairway to Forgotten Cinema
description: A woman in a sparkling dark evening gown ascends a grand, damaged staircase inside a decaying old theater. She holds the railing with one hand while film strips, photographs, and scattered papers litter the steps around her under dramatic beams of light from above.
prompt: A woman in a shimmering dark sequined gown ascends a wide marble staircase inside a ruined vintage movie theater. The walls are covered in peeling classical murals and framed pictures. Old film strips, photographs, and papers are scattered across the steps.
